Easily the best fine dining restaurant in Hoi An
Sep 2026 • Family
If you are visiting Hoi An and want a fine dining experience with a plethora of options, look no further. Morning Glory is in my opinion by far the best restaurant in Hoi An. There are however three stories and they provide three different levels of service.
Level 1: Simple, cheaper options
Level2: More targeting Vietnamese and cheaper than the third level
Level 3: Signature Restaurant (Fine dining of the highest level), more options than you’ll ever need, not a bad wine list for Vietnam and the food is nothing short of exceptional

Chaotic and over hyped
Aug 2026 • Couples
Unfortunately, our experience at Morning Glory Signature was very disappointing.

It was chaotic from the moment we arrived. Our table wasn’t ready, and we were asked to stand in a corner and look at the menu while we waited. When we were eventually seated, the table hadn’t even been properly prepared with cutlery. The tables are also extremely close together, which makes the whole experience feel cramped and hectic.

The food didn’t improve matters. The mango in the mango salad was so unripe that it was virtually inedible. None of our dishes arrived together, meaning we couldn’t really enjoy the meal as a group, and one of the dishes was completely wrong.

It feels like a restaurant that has become a victim of its own success. They simply didn’t seem able to cope with the number of customers they were serving.

Sadly, it wasn’t an enjoyable dining experience and certainly didn’t live up to the reputation.

Lucky to try this as my first lunch in hoi an
Aug 2026 • Friends
After eating my way through Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi, Da Nang, and Hoi An, this ended up being my favorite Vietnamese restaurant of the trip.

The food was outstanding from start to finish. Every dish we ordered was full of flavor, beautifully prepared, and you could tell they use great ingredients. The menu is huge, so there’s something for everyone, but everything we tried was excellent.

The restaurant was packed, which is always a good sign, but the service was still efficient and friendly. 

If you’re in Hoi An and want really good Vietnamese food, I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend Morning Glory Signature. I’d happily come back the next time I’m here.

Also I forgot to take all the pictures of the dishes I ordered but I’ll put up what I took.
